svg.title: \begin{array}{l}\widetilde {r_S} = \frac {{E'{}_{S1}}}{{E_{S1}}} = \frac {{n_1\cos i_1 - n_2\cos i_2}}{{n_1\cos i_1 + n_2\cos i_2}} = \frac {{\sin (i_1 - i_2)}}{{\sin (i_1 + i_2)}}\\\widetilde {r_P} = \frac {{E'{}_{P1}}}{{E_{P1}}} = \frac {{n_2\cos i_1 - n_1\cos i_2}}{{n_2\cos i_1 + n_1\cos i_2}} = \frac {{\tan (i_1 - i_2)}}{{\tan (i_1 + i_2)}}\end{array}
